messages:
maya: Heads-up — Audit asked for a continuous export of security logs to an external vendor (VendorX) for 3 years. They want server_access, auth_events, and alerts. They also want them KMS-wrapped and ACLed. Any objections?
jon: what's the export vehicle? s3 push? direct syslog?
maya: vendor wants S3 PUTs into their bucket + cross-account role. They asked for kms:Encrypt on their key.
liam: cross-account write + external KMS gives me pause. We should avoid giving external KMS keys write perms directly. Prefer: we push to our bucket, encrypt with our KMS, then deliver via transfer job to vendor over TLS with envelope encryption.
ariel: compliance note: 3y retention is ok for audit logs, but PII should be minimized. Need to confirm which fields in server_access are considered PII and redact or pseudonymize before export.
maya: agreed. can we add a filter step for IP/email hashing?
liam: yes. propose a short pipeline: collector -> redact/hashing lambda (or k8s job) -> internal-s3 (kms:our-key) -> transfer-runner assumes role -> push to vendor. Keep push creds ephemeral.
jon: how do we do ephemeral creds? can we use STS AssumeRole with an external ID and time-limited session?
liam: exactly. use AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity or STS AssumeRole for that transfer runner. Vault or IAM role with 1h sessions. Also rotate access keys on job restart.
ariel: add approval gating: any archive longer than 90d needs a justification ticket and DPO sign-off. For 3y we need that sign-off.
maya: noted, I'll open a ticket. Also, Audit asked whether SOC should be able to pull exports ad-hoc. We want to avoid broad perms.
liam: let's avoid granting sec-soc full bucket read. Instead implement an ephemeral proxy that grants scoped read tokens per-request. pattern: sec-proxy service that checks JIT request, logs action to audit index, then issues pre-signed URL valid for 30m.
jon: +1. That keeps RBAC minimal. Which groups get JIT approval? sec-leads + compliance?
ariel: sec-leads + audit on a rotation, plus product security for high-sensitivity queries. We'll provide a roster.
maya: small ops question: if vendor rotates their KMS, will it break the cross-account push?
liam: if they manage their own key, they need kms:Encrypt using their key arn. We shouldn't give them decrypt on our side. Better: we encrypt with our key during staging; deliver to vendor over TLS; vendor can re-encrypt on their side using their KMS after receipt.
ariel: add to policy: no PII fields in plain text on export. If pseudonymization can't be guaranteed, deny export.
maya: vulnerability triage: @liam are we comfortable exporting now that we have CVE-2025-4578 in the vendor transfer library?
liam: not until we patch. I'll open a vuln-triage ticket and mark export paused for that component. ticket: SEC-4578.
jon: if we need emergency cutoff during an incident (e.g., exfil attempt), what's the kill switch?
liam: three layers: 1) disable transfer-runner role assume (IAM deny policy toggle); 2) revoke transfer task's session tokens (Vault rotate); 3) lifecycle: move staging bucket to deny ACL (s3 block public/deny). Also rotate KMS CMK key policy to deny encrypt from that principal.
ariel: document that in runbook. Also require post-incident forensic copy to be stored in immutable archive with access controls.
maya: I'll draft runbook and share. For implementation: can someone drop a minimal IAM policy snippet for the assume-role + pre-signed-url flow?
liam: quick snippet:```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [{
    "Effect": "Allow",
    "Action": "sts:AssumeRole",
    "Resource": "arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:role/transfer-runner",
    "Condition": {"NumericLessThanEquals": {"sts:DurationSeconds":"3600"}}
  }]
}
```
jon: perfect. we'll tuck that behind deploy gate.
deploy-bot: deploy finished: transfer-runner v1.4.2 to prod at 2024-11-08T16:12:03Z :rocket:
maya: timing looks good. next steps: 1) ariel collects DPO sign-off 2) liam files SEC-4578 triage & blocks transfer for that component until remediated 3) jon and infra implement JIT proxy + pre-signed URL. I'll update ticket with runbook link when done.
ariel: will loop in DPO. +1 on JIT proxy.
liam: I'll start the vuln triage now.
maya: thanks team :thumbsup:
